answer: Reviewers stake on every verdict and a random spot check reopens one in ten of them. A verdict that fails its check is published with the reviewer's address attached. Each grade is also re-read by a reviewer holding no position in the task. The mirror is unforgiving: a farm that seats its own reviewers survives only until the check lands, and then a whole ocean of standing drains through one published address. Cost to a thousand-identity outfit is a thousand stakes at risk for a ten percent audit rate, a losing vertex in any payout matrix.
